challenges.title: All Lights On
challenges.task:
Make every light on the panel shine, then stop.
LEDS ●●●●●●●● = 255
hints: MVI A 11 111 111, then OUT 377 and HLT.

challenges.title: Two Patterns
challenges.task:
Show 11110000 and then 00001111 on the lights.
LEDS ●●●●○○○○ = 240
LEDS ○○○○●●●● = 15
hints: MVI A, the pattern, OUT 377 — twice.

challenges.title: Add Three Numbers
challenges.task:
Work out 40 + 25 + 17 with MVI A and two ADIs, and show it.
LEDS ○●○●○○●○ = 82
hints: MVI A 40, ADI 25, ADI 17.
Then OUT 377, HLT.

challenges.title: Below Zero
challenges.task:
Show what 3 - 5 looks like in one byte (with SUI), then 0 - 1.
LEDS ●●●●●●●○ = 254
LEDS ●●●●●●●● = 255
hints: MVI A 3, SUI 5, OUT 377.
MVI A 0, SUI 1, OUT 377, HLT.

challenges.title: Octal Steps
challenges.task:
Write a program in octal only that shows octal 001, 010 and 100 on the lights.
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
LEDS ○○○○●○○○ = 8
LEDS ○●○○○○○○ = 64
hints: 076 001 323 377 shows the first one.
Each octal digit is three switches: 010 is 00 001 000.

challenges.title: Adding in Octal
challenges.task:
Add octal 125 and 052 with ADI and show the result. Write the program in octal.
LEDS ○●●●●●●● = 127
hints: 125 + 052 = 177 in octal: no carries between the digits.

challenges.title: Three-Way Swap
challenges.task:
Put 1 in B, 2 in C and 3 in D. Move them around so B gets C's value, C gets D's and D gets B's. Show B, C and D.
LEDS ○○○○○○●○ = 2
LEDS ○○○○○○●● = 3
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
hints: Park B in E: MOV E,B (130).
MOV B,C, MOV C,D, MOV D,E.
Show each with MOV A,r and OUT 377.

challenges.title: Wrap Around
challenges.task:
Load 254 into B. INR B twice, showing B after each step.
LEDS ●●●●●●●● = 255
LEDS ○○○○○○○○ = 0
hints: MVI B 254, INR B, MOV A,B, OUT 377.
Again, then HLT.

challenges.title: Times Five
challenges.task:
Multiply 23 by 5 without a loop (×4 + ×1) and show it.
LEDS ○●●●○○●● = 115
hints: Save the original: MOV B,A.
ADD A twice gives ×4, ADD B adds ×1.

challenges.title: The Difference
challenges.task:
Put 90 in B and 35 in C. Show B - C using SUB.
LEDS ○○●●○●●● = 55
hints: MOV A,B, SUB C (221).

challenges.title: Swap Two Bytes
challenges.task:
Put 11 and 22 after HLT. Swap them in memory with LDA/STA, then show the first byte and the second byte.
LEDS ○○○●○●●○ = 22
LEDS ○○○○●○●● = 11
hints: LDA first, MOV B,A, LDA second, STA first, MOV A,B, STA second.
Then LDA first, OUT; LDA second, OUT; HLT.

challenges.title: Fill Memory
challenges.task:
Write 7 into the three bytes at addresses 200, 201 and 202 using LXI H, MVI M (066) and INX H. Then add them up with LDA and show the sum.
LEDS ○○○●○●○● = 21
hints: LXI H 200, MVI M 7, INX H, MVI M 7, INX H, MVI M 7.
LDA 200, MOV B,A, … or walk again with MOV A,M and ADD M.

challenges.title: Jump Around
challenges.task:
Start with MVI A 1, then JMP over an ADI 100 to an ADI 2, and show the result.
LEDS ○○○○○○●● = 3
hints: MVI A 1 (2 bytes), JMP (3 bytes), ADI 100 (2 bytes): the ADI 2 is at address 007.

challenges.title: Show It Twice
challenges.task:
Show 42, then jump back to show it again, but only once: use register B as a flag (0 the first time, 1 the second) and a conditional jump to stop.
LEDS ○○●○●○●○ = 42
LEDS ○○●○●○●○ = 42
hints: MVI B 0, show: MVI A 42, OUT 377, then MOV A,B, CPI 1, JZ end.
INR B, JMP show. end: HLT.

challenges.title: The Smaller One
challenges.task:
B is 30, C is 12. Show the smaller one, using CMP and a conditional jump.
LEDS ○○○○●●○○ = 12
hints: MOV A,B, CMP C: carry set means B is smaller.
JC show, otherwise MOV A,C. show: OUT 377.

challenges.title: Exactly Ten?
challenges.task:
Read the sense switches twice. Each time, show 255 if the value is exactly 10, else 0 (use CPI and JZ). The switches are 10 and 12.
LEDS ●●●●●●●● = 255
LEDS ○○○○○○○○ = 0
hints: IN 377, CPI 10, JZ yes, XRA A, JMP show; yes: MVI A 255; show: OUT 377.
A loop with a counter, or the same code twice.

challenges.title: 1 to 10
challenges.task:
Add up 1 + 2 + … + 10 with a loop and show the result.
LEDS ○○●●○●●● = 55
hints: Count B down from 10, and ADD B into A each round.
MVI B 10, XRA A, loop: ADD B, DCR B, JNZ loop.

challenges.title: The Largest in a Table
challenges.task:
Five bytes after HLT: 17, 88, 43, 91, 26. Find the largest with a loop over the table (HL, M, CMP) and show it.
LEDS ○●○●●○●● = 91

requirements.message: Walk through the table with LXI H.
Compare with CMP M (or CMP r).

hints: Start with A = 0 and B = 5 as the counter.
CMP M: if carry, the byte at HL is bigger: MOV A,M.
INX H, DCR B, JNZ loop.

challenges.title: The Lower Half
challenges.task:
Read the sense switches and show only their lower 4 bits (ANI). The switches are 10110110.
LEDS ○○○○○●●○ = 6
hints: IN 377, ANI 017, OUT 377, HLT.

challenges.title: Blink
challenges.task:
Start with 10101010 and show it 4 times, flipping all bits with XRI 377 in between, with a loop.
LEDS ●○●○●○●○ = 170
LEDS ○●○●○●○● = 85
LEDS ●○●○●○●○ = 170
LEDS ○●○●○●○● = 85
hints: MVI A 252 (octal), MVI B 4.
loop: OUT 377, XRI 377, DCR B, JNZ loop.

challenges.title: Bounce
challenges.task:
A light runs from bit 0 up to bit 3 (RLC), then back down to bit 0 (RRC): show 1, 2, 4, 8, 4, 2, 1.
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
LEDS ○○○○○○●○ = 2
LEDS ○○○○○●○○ = 4
LEDS ○○○○●○○○ = 8
LEDS ○○○○○●○○ = 4
LEDS ○○○○○○●○ = 2
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
hints: Two loops: 3 RLCs, then 3 RRCs, showing A each time.
Show the first 1 before the first loop.

challenges.title: Count the Bits
challenges.task:
Count the 1 bits of the sense switches (10110101) by rotating A 8 times and counting the carries in C. Show the count.
LEDS ○○○○○●○● = 5

requirements.message: Test the carry with JNC or JC.

hints: IN 377, MVI B 8, MVI C 0.
loop: RRC, JNC skip, INR C, skip: DCR B, JNZ loop.
MOV A,C, OUT 377.

challenges.title: Echo the Switches
challenges.task:
Read the sense switches 3 times and show each setting on the lights. The switches are 1, 2 and 3.
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
LEDS ○○○○○○●○ = 2
LEDS ○○○○○○●● = 3
hints: IN 377, OUT 377 — three times, or in a loop.

challenges.title: Switch Calculator
challenges.task:
Read two numbers from the sense switches and show their sum. The switches are 100 and 55.
LEDS ●○○●●○●● = 155
hints: IN 377, MOV B,A, IN 377, ADD B, OUT 377.

challenges.title: Add Ten
challenges.task:
Write a subroutine that adds 10 to A. Starting with A = 5, call it three times, showing A after each call.
LEDS ○○○○●●●● = 15
LEDS ○○○●●○○● = 25
LEDS ○○●○○○●● = 35
hints: add10: ADI 10, RET.
Main: MVI A 5, CALL add10, OUT 377 — three times.

challenges.title: A Max Routine
challenges.task:
Write a subroutine max that leaves the bigger of A and B in A. Use it for 12/40 and 99/7 and show both results.
LEDS ○○●○●○○○ = 40
LEDS ○●●○○○●● = 99
hints: max: CMP B, RNC (320) or JNC back to a RET, MOV A,B, RET.
Main: MVI A 12, MVI B 40, CALL max, OUT 377, …

challenges.title: Save and Restore
challenges.task:
Put 5 in B and 6 in C. PUSH B, overwrite both with 0, POP B, and show B and C.
LEDS ○○○○○●○● = 5
LEDS ○○○○○●●○ = 6
hints: MVI B 5, MVI C 6, PUSH B, MVI B 0, MVI C 0, POP B.
MOV A,B, OUT 377, MOV A,C, OUT 377.

challenges.title: Swap with the Stack
challenges.task:
Swap the pairs BC and DE using only PUSH and POP (no MOV). B=1, C=2, D=3, E=4. Then show B and D.
LEDS ○○○○○○●● = 3
LEDS ○○○○○○○● = 1
hints: PUSH B, PUSH D, POP B, POP D.
The last one pushed is the first one popped.

challenges.title: ABC
challenges.task: Print ABC on the Teletype: MVI A 'A' (101), OUT 001, then INR A and OUT 001 twice.

requirements.message: Step to the next letter with INR A.

hints: MVI A 101, OUT 001, INR A, OUT 001, INR A, OUT 001, HLT.

challenges.title: The Alphabet
challenges.task: Print the whole alphabet A to Z on the Teletype with a loop.
hints: MVI A 101 ('A'), MVI B 26 (032 octal).
loop: OUT 001, INR A, DCR B, JNZ loop.
